system.description: You cause a device's power supply to surge, damaging or destroying it, with a range of up to 10 times your permanent Willpower in yards (bidding an extra Mental Trait if not touching it). Devices have Traits based on complexity-three for household items, six for cars, nine or more for mainframes or aircraft-determined via a Static Mental Challenge. Spending a Mental Trait and winning a Simple Test destroys the target outright instead of merely damaging it.
